name: Ride the train to Cactus
desc:
Welcome to Ride the train to Cactus (RtttC)!
Drive the cute and unique trains to reach the goal with the cactus!
Please be careful to drive carefully as it is very easy to derail the train!
Once you get used to the game, challenge Time Attack and try to set a world record!
When you reach all the goals...?
If the game is very rough, please use the private server.
